name: ptee-staged-and-lockout
title: Ship it safely: staged policy and avoiding lockout
summary: The scariest moment in network policy is the first Deny in production. A StagedGlobalNetworkPolicy runs through the same matching machinery but enforces nothing - a dry run that changes the connectivity matrix by exactly nothing - so you can preview a lockdown before it bites. Plus the allow-first safe-mode habit that keeps you from locking yourself out.
